cvStructure.issue: Your CV has no Skills section, even though tools like AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Prometheus, Grafana, Ansible and Helm appear in your Experience and Projects entries.
cvStructure.suggestion: Add a Skills or Technical Skills section listing these tools so an ATS scanning for keywords can find them easily.

keywordUsage.issue: In the Junior DevOps Engineer entry you wrote "Kubernets" instead of the official product name.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Change "Kubernets" to "Kubernetes" in that bullet point.

keywordUsage.issue: In the Junior DevOps Engineer entry you wrote "Git Hub Actions" with a space, which is not the official product name.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Change "Git Hub Actions" to "GitHub Actions" to match the official spelling.

keywordUsage.issue: You wrote "Terrafrom" in the Junior DevOps Engineer entry, but later correctly spelled it "Terraform" in your HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate certification, so the spelling is inconsistent.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Correct "Terrafrom" to "Terraform" so it matches the spelling used in your certification.

readability.issue: In the Cloud Operations Intern entry, the points "Monitoring", "Server stuff and deployments" and "Helping with tickets" are vague duty labels without action verbs or specific details.
readability.suggestion: Rewrite each as a short point starting with an action verb, for example "Monitored [systems] for [issue type]" or "Resolved [number] support tickets related to [topic]".

readability.issue: The Graduation project description is written as a first-person story: "A system for the university. I worked on the servers part with my team and it was successful."
readability.suggestion: Rewrite it as short points starting with an action verb, naming what you built on the server side and adding a specific result, for example "Configured [number] servers for [purpose], achieving [result]".

contentFormatting.issue: Your Summary says "over 3 years of professional experience", but your Experience section only lists the Cloud Operations Intern role (Jun 2025 - Aug 2025) and the Junior DevOps Engineer role (Mar 2026 - Present), which together are under 1 year.
contentFormatting.suggestion: Update the Summary to match your actual experience length, or adjust it once your total professional experience reaches 3 years.

contentFormatting.issue: The Self-hosted Git server project is dated only "(2025)", while every other entry uses a Month YYYY format or a Month YYYY to Month YYYY range.
contentFormatting.suggestion: Add a specific month to the Self-hosted Git server project date so it matches the format used elsewhere in your CV.
